description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to kubeadm configuration, including initialization, joining nodes, cluster configuration, control plane components, and related options.

classes.name: InitConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration specific to 'kubeadm init' process, including bootstrap tokens, node registration, API endpoint, and patches.

classes.name: ClusterConfiguration
classes.description: Cluster-wide configuration for kubeadm, including etcd, networking, control plane components, and feature gates.

classes.name: ControlPlaneComponent
classes.description: Settings common to control plane components such as extra arguments and volumes.

classes.name: APIServer
classes.description: Configuration for API server deployment, including SANs and timeout.

classes.name: DNS
classes.description: Configuration for DNS add-on, including image customization.

classes.name: ImageMeta
classes.description: Metadata for customizing container images used in components.

classes.name: APIEndpoint
classes.description: Represents API server endpoint details such as address and port.

classes.name: NodeRegistrationOptions
classes.description: Options for registering nodes or control-plane nodes, including taints, extra args, and image pull policy.

classes.name: Discovery
classes.description: Options for kubelet TLS bootstrap discovery, including bootstrap tokens and kubeconfig files.

classes.name: BootstrapTokenDiscovery
classes.description: Details for bootstrap token-based discovery, including token, API server endpoint, and CA hashes.

classes.name: FileDiscovery
classes.description: Specifies a kubeconfig file or URL for cluster info.

classes.name: HostPathMount
classes.description: Describes host volumes mounted into pods.

classes.name: Patches
classes.description: Options for applying patches to components during kubeadm operations.

classes.name: JoinConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration for joining nodes to a cluster, including registration, discovery, and control plane options.

classes.name: JoinControlPlane
classes.description: Details for deploying additional control plane instances during join.
